prompt:
Create ONE landscape 3:2 mood board sheet for a Minecraft 1.21.1 survival building catalog, titled "SEARS MODERN HOMES | 1908–1940". Plain warm light background, crisp authentic Minecraft voxel geometry and vanilla block textures only, attractive architectural catalog layout, no characters or animals. This is an eight-house sample STREET ROW, not one hybrid mansion. Large upper hero: all EIGHT distinct houses in a single continuous row on eight equal plots, seen from the north street in an elevated front axonometric view, numbered 0–7 and named clearly. Each is small enough to fit a 16-block-wide by 20-block-deep plot; dimension annotation "8 × 16 = 128 blocks" and "plots z 5–24". Street along x: gravel z 0–2, smooth stone sidewalk z 3–4, lawns beyond. Houses face north, front walks and lawns without front fences. All building parts including eaves and chimneys inside their own plot. Consistent suburban era, distinct silhouettes.
House 0 MAGNOLIA: white clapboard Georgian Colonial Revival, 2½ storeys, symmetrical five-bay facade, tall white full-height portico columns, balcony over central door, dark side-gabled roof and dormers.
1 ALHAMBRA: two-storey warm cream stucco Mission Revival, stepped voxel curved shaped parapet gables, round-arch arcaded front porch made with stepped blocks, low red roof edges.
2 VALLONIA: sage Craftsman bungalow, 1½ storeys, side-gabled dark roof sweeping over full-width porch, broad dormer, tapered posts on brick piers, exposed rafter tails and knee braces.
3 PURITAN: pale yellow Dutch Colonial, gambrel roof with long shed dormer, small pedimented columned entry, two storeys under gambrel.
4 CORNELL: grey American Foursquare, two-storey cube, low hip roof and front hipped dormer, full-width one-storey porch with square posts.
5 STANFORD / CAPE COD: white 1½-storey cottage, steep side gable, two gabled dormers, centered door, shuttered paired windows, central masonry chimney.
6 WINONA: modest single-storey cream front-gabled cottage, small sheltered porch beneath the gable, simple cared-for starter home.
7 CRAFTSMAN: two storeys, broad front gable, shingle upper floor and sage clapboard below, broad porch on stone piers, deep bracketed eaves.
Below the hero place THREE small thumbnail takes on the WHOLE eight-house row, each showing all eight distinct silhouettes in the same order and fixed grid: "A · compact massing", "B · roof rhythm", "C · porch alignment". Modest variation in roof pitch and porch arrangement while preserving each catalog identity.
Bottom band: a tidy strip of actual voxel block swatches grouped by role, with exact legible Minecraft ids beneath. WALLS: minecraft:birch_planks, minecraft:white_terracotta, minecraft:smooth_sandstone, minecraft:green_terracotta; TRIM: minecraft:quartz_pillar; ROOF: minecraft:deepslate_tile_stairs, minecraft:brick_stairs, minecraft:dark_prismarine_stairs; WINDOWS: minecraft:glass_pane; ACCENTS: minecraft:stone_bricks, minecraft:bricks, minecraft:spruce_trapdoor. Use only vanilla blocks existing in 1.21.1, no pale oak, no mod blocks. Preserve pixel textures rather than smooth photoreal materials.
Include FOUR detailed close-up callout panels with crisp block-count-aware drawings: 1 "CRAFTSMAN EAVE" deep overhang, rafter tails, bracket and pier; 2 "WINDOW RHYTHM" framed double-hung pairs and triples, Cape shutters; 3 "ACCESSIBLE ENTRY" lawn to door with two bottom-slab half-rise transitions, maximum ground floor one block above lawn, 2×2 level landing and last cell level before door, no stair stoop or full-block rise; 4 "WALL HEARTH + FLUE" architectural cutaway of masonry integrated into wall, campfire at bottom with hay hidden beneath floor, smoke in enclosed 1×1 air flue, constant-width masonry through roof with roof stopped at stack, open mouth 1–2 courses above roof, no crown. Add a tiny furnished sectional inset within the fourth panel showing a low ground floor parlour/dining/kitchen with stove and table, upstairs family bedrooms with 3–4 whole beds, heads against solid walls with two clear blocks above, reachable circulation and stair top flush with upstairs floor; lamps for spawn prevention. Keep the board focused on visible street identities, readable swatch lettering, and architectural details. No loose blocks outside plots, no front fences, no fantasy turrets, no vehicles, no watermark.
reads: Eight named catalog houses form one coordinated street, with open front lawns, individual walks, a continuous sidewalk and gravel road.
Magnolia reads through its white symmetrical facade, tall columned portico, central balcony and roof dormers.
Alhambra stands out through cream stucco, a shaped Mission parapet, arched porch openings and red roof edges.
Vallonia has a low sage bungalow silhouette, broad dormer and full-width porch sheltered by the roof.
Puritan has a pale yellow facade, long upper dormer and small pedimented entry; the pictured roof only weakly expresses the requested gambrel.
Cornell reads as a grey two-storey cube with a hipped roof, central dormer and full-width porch.
Stanford has a steep dark roof, two white gabled dormers, centered entrance and shuttered windows.
Winona is the modest single-storey front-gabled cottage; the closing Craftsman is taller, with shingle siding, deep eaves and stone porch piers.
The swatch strip names vanilla block materials, while four callouts show Craftsman brackets, grouped windows, slab access and a masonry hearth/flue section.
